input.question: When was the National Indian Association formed?

documents.text: Association, and was voluntarily dissolved in 1951. The Association first began as a petition drive to persuade Congress to uphold Indian treaties. Initially founded in 1879 in reaction to the prospect of opening Oklahoma Indian Territory to white settlement, additional branches quickly expanded in the 1880s. At its peak the Association supported 98 branch organizations in 28 states and sustained 56 mission statements on Indian reservations. The first crusade was a five year mission devoted to gaining political rights for Indians. Soon, sixteen states were included in the movement. In 1882, the male-dominated Indian Rights Association commandeered the lobbying functions
